title: Temporally distributed persistent-memory exposure as a standalone causal mechanism
dead_end_scope: On the frozen ALFWorld persistent-memory substrate, treating repeated memory injection, cumulative exposure duration, or preregistered ON/OFF exposure windows as a new standalone agent-specific causal mechanism after local-state/action mechanisms have failed.

counter_explanation.statement: The frozen memory treatment is re-injected at every policy decision until termination, so fixed ON/OFF memory is a repeated longitudinal treatment regimen. Predetermined ON/OFF windows, cumulative exposure, mediation through treatment-affected history/state, and termination-dependent opportunity for future exposure are representable by the same treatment-history/state-history objects used by longitudinal/dynamic-treatment causal models; persistence or textual memory does not by itself create a new causal primitive.
counter_explanation.opposite_prediction: For any prospectively fixed memory-exposure schedule on this substrate, the endpoint distribution can be expressed as a function of the same pre-outcome treatment history and treatment-affected state/history. If earlier treatment changes later state, monitoring, or the number of remaining decision opportunities, longitudinal treatment/monitoring formulations already absorb that dependence. Therefore an ON/OFF-window or cumulative-dose effect is not an irreducible agent-specific mechanism merely because the intervention is persistent memory.
counter_explanation.opposite_principle: Persistent context is a repeated intervention, not a new causal primitive.
counter_explanation.opposite_search_seed: Search only for a setting in which self-evolution changes the executable semantics or version identity of the persistent treatment itself, rather than only its timing or duration. Any such seed must first beat nonstationary/versioned-treatment models, dynamic policy-regime changes, intervention-mapping drift, and concept-drift explanations under the same observable version/history information.
counter_explanation.scope: Frozen ALFWorld HFAdmissiblePolicy persistent-memory runs in which the same MEMORY:: artifact is passed into policy.choose at every decision step until terminal success/failure or the step cap, including any prospective fixed exposure-window variant that changes only whether that same artifact is present at each step.
alternative_explanations_ruled_out: one-time initial-state perturbation: the first-party harness passes the same patch to policy.choose inside the decision loop and reconstructs the system prompt with MEMORY:: content on every step
local earliest-action carrier: the prior C2 readjudication already stopped that mechanism while preserving the broad memory phenomenon
static local decision-boundary/admissibility carrier: the preregistered same-information augmentation failed to improve the baseline and is already recorded as a local-mechanism stop
endpoint-duration mechanism: terminal length and full-trajectory distance are post-outcome/leakage variables and are explicitly excluded from the prospective residual contract
counter_explanation.reopen_condition: Reopen only if a preregistered case matches the full pre-outcome history and nominal exposure schedule yet changes the executable semantics/version of the persistent artifact, yields a distinct ex-ante prediction, and an explicit same-information nonstationary/versioned-treatment or policy-regime model given the same observable version signal cannot express that prediction. A new timing window, longer exposure, cumulative-dose statistic, K-step label, or memory terminology is insufficient.

structural_witness.implementation_fact: run_episode repeatedly calls policy.choose(..., patch, ...) inside the while loop; HFAdmissiblePolicy.choose appends the MEMORY:: artifact to the system prompt whenever patch is nonempty.
structural_witness.treatment_schedule_interpretation: The same persistent-memory artifact is therefore re-administered at every decision step until termination.
causal_reduction: fixed MEMORY ON/OFF -> static repeated longitudinal regimen
preregistered ON->OFF or OFF->ON window -> time-varying/dynamic treatment regimen
state/history changed by earlier memory exposure -> treatment-affected time-varying state/confounding
episode termination changes the number of future exposure opportunities -> treatment-dependent follow-up/monitoring or truncation

scientific_interpretation.safe_claim: No temporal-exposure experiment is needed to kill the standalone claim that repeated or windowed persistent-memory exposure is a new causal primitive on this frozen substrate. The implementation exposes a repeated treatment regimen, and a previously certified same-information mature-theory reduction already covers treatment-affected longitudinal history and monitoring. The B-9/C2 context-dependent memory-effect phenomenon remains archived positive residual evidence; only this temporal-exposure mechanism class is closed.
do_not_say: persistent memory has no temporal effects
a K-step or window experiment failed
longitudinal causal inference explains the empirical endpoint labels without further modeling
